card.text: A Cepheid in the Large Magellanic Cloud, 74 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 14.2 days.

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 73.9 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 42,626 parsecs away.

color.title: Colour
color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
